name: sylvan_scavenging_no_raccoon_without_your_big_creature
note: Sylvan Scavenging: 'At the beginning of your end step, choose one -- ... Create a 3/3 green Raccoon creature token if you control a creature with power 4 or greater.' At P0's end step P0 chooses the Raccoon mode, but P0's only creature is a 2/2 (the opponent's 5/5 is not P0's): no Raccoon is created. At P0's next end step P0 controls a 4/4 Brute (entered that turn) and the same mode makes exactly one 3/3 Raccoon. P0 declines every attack.
